# ChuMicro

> Open-source Python libraries and host tools for microcontrollers.  One codebase runs on CircuitPython, MicroPython, and CPython.

## Projects

- [ChuMicro](https://chumicro.com/ChuMicro/): Wifi, MQTT, HTTP client and server, WebSockets, network time, timers, settings, and storage that survives a reboot, plus the host tools that deploy them and watch a board.  One codebase runs on CircuitPython, MicroPython, and CPython.

## Optional

- [ChuMicro library and tool index](https://chumicro.com/ChuMicro/llms.txt): every package with a one-line description and its documentation address.
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/ChuMicro): every public repository.
